name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods from OGs-Sandbox: install only the ones you want.

plugins.name: cost-guard
plugins.description: Holds a message that would cost more than your token or dollar limit (cold prompt cache or a very large message), explains why, and asks before sending. Can also keep the cache warm during a break.

plugins.name: read-aloud
plugins.description: Reads Claude's replies and plans aloud, whole or just the text you selected, with a Stop button while it reads.
